title: Σύνοψις χρονική, Synopsis Chronike; «Хроника» Константина Манассии
author: Constantine Manasses
genre: Verse world chronicle in political verse
edition: Lampsidis 1996 (CFHB 36); Bekker 1837 (CSHB, public domain; URL not checked).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Константин Манассия': Russian only of excerpts from the Middle Bulgarian Slavonic version (Polyvyannyi 1990, vostlit.info). Kantemir's 18th-c. translation survives in manuscript (doi 10.31860/2712-7591-2020-1-176-180). No modern Russian from the Greek.
en_evidence: Yuretich 2018, The Chronicle of Constantine Manasses (Liverpool UP; doi 10.2307/jj.38238666).
value: A formative text for Slavic and Russian chronography, yet Russian readers know it only through Slavonic. Its sections on antiquity (Troy, Persia, Alexander, Rome) show Byzantine retelling of ancient history.
ai_feasibility: High. Ornate but regular verse; the English translation is available for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Sections on antiquity (Troy, Alexander), about 700 verses (to be delimited)
